title: video_generate has no CAS claim and startup recovery re-enqueues live jobs, duplicating B-roll clips, video_files rows and storage objects
Only 2 of 11 job types are durable, so the dedicated worker container runs almost nothing and export/transcode/podcast render stay on the web tier
QUEUE_OPTIONS never reach an existing queue: createQueue is INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING and updateQueue is never called
Dead-letter queues are created but nothing consumes, reads or alerts on them before retention deletes the jobs
singletonKey is inert under the default standard queue policy, so the documented pending-job dedupe never happens
QUEUE_CROP_CONCURRENCY sets localConcurrency for every queue including video_generate, which then blocks on its own semaphore while marked active
pg-boss send fallback runs heavy jobs inline in the API container, which registers no workers in the shipped topology
Graceful shutdown gives inline jobs 25s then exits, so every redeploy kills an in-flight export or podcast render mid-encode
runVideoTranscode takes no claim, so two concurrent runs for one video both flip the master pointer and orphan an HLS tree
recoverStuckTranscodes runs only at boot with a 30-minute cutoff and has no periodic sweeper, so a redeploy-killed transcode can spin forever
Queue tests are frozen at 4 job names and tsconfig excludes *.test.ts from typecheck, so the exhaustive-map alarm never fires
metadata handler dedupes only with a process-local Set and a non-atomic status read, with no cluster-safe claim
Three Trigger.dev tasks are declared and never triggered, yet the SDK is imported and evaluated on every boot
Queue doc comments describe a passed phase; pgBossDriver.ts:14 wrongly asserts every handler is CAS-claimed
QUEUE_PGBOSS_LISTEN=1 establishes the listener but no queue sets notify:true, so LISTEN/NOTIFY is inert
Batch worker loop fails a whole batch on one throw; latent only because pg-boss batchSize defaults to 1
